/****************/

.remark-slide-content{

padding:1em 2em;

}

    display:block;

    height:95vh;

}

.geo-slide{
  padding:0 !important;
  position:relative;
  background:#111;
}

.geo-slide h1{
  position:absolute;
  top:18px;
  left:40px;
  z-index:2;
  margin:0;
  font-size:1.6em;
  color:white;
  text-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.75);
}

.geo-slide img{
  width:100vw;
  height:100vh;
  object-fit:contain;
}

.geo-caption{
  position:absolute;
  left:40px;
  right:40px;
  bottom:28px;
  z-index:2;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.68);
  color:white;
  padding:14px 22px;
  border-radius:16px;
  font-size:.82em;
  line-height:1.25;
}

.geo-caption-center{
  position:absolute;
  top:50%;
  left:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  z-index:2;

  width:70%;

  background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);
  color:white;

  padding:25px;
  border-radius:16px;

  text-align:center;
  font-size:1.2em;
}

# Hidrografía computacional de RD

<br>

- DEM ASF–JAXA (~12.5 m)
- GRASS GIS
- ~98,000 km de drenajes
- ~129,000 cursos extraídos
- Orden máximo: 8

Preprint disponible:
.small[
https://preprints.scielo.org/index.php/scielo/preprint/view/7056/version/7462
]

]
